en: The postcard features a large, imposing stone monument of a standing figure on a stepped pedestal, set in a landscaped park with a flower bed in the foreground and benches along the pathways. Behind the monument, the sea is visible, with trees surrounding the area. The back of the postcard has printed text in several languages (Bulgarian, French, German), including the location 'VARNA', and mentions a monument dedicated to anti-fascist fighters.
